subject: Plotting LOD score against genetic map along a genome

messages.author: b7fa5e1284b8884a
messages.subject: Plotting LOD score against genetic map along a genome
parts:
Hi, all

I have a results of QTL analysis with four information: names of markers, chromosome, genetic map and values of LOD score. I would like to plot theses results in along a genome. In x-axis, I want to plot number of chromosome and y-axis the LOD score value.

How can I figure out this plot?

I hope someone can help me.

Thanks.

Rodrigo.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Plotting LOD score against genetic map along a genome
parts:
Create a data frame with three columns: "chr", "pos", and "lod", with chromosome IDs (as a factor), genetic map positions, and the LOD scores.  Include marker names as row names.

Then give it class "scanone":

  class(myobject) <- "scanone"

Then you should be able to use plot.scanone to get a plot of the LOD curves:

  plot(myobject)

karl
